author: Philip K. Dick
card_summary: A five-page scan continuing Folder 18 of Dick's Exegesis for August 1978, preserving pages 6 through 10 as raw archival images of the handwritten journal.
page_summary:
This item reproduces pages 6 through 10 of Folder 18 of Dick's Exegesis, dated August 1978, continuing directly from the pages 1-5 scan. Like its companion, it is a manuscript image rather than a transcription or edited selection, drawn from the vast private journal Dick maintained from 1974 to 1982.

The documentary function is the point: the scan lets researchers follow the physical and argumentative sequence of a single Exegesis folder across ten consecutive pages, observing how Dick's late-1978 speculations unfold on the page before any editor intervened.

The portal holds one archive manifestation. Read together with pages 1-5 of the same folder, and against the published editions and the portal's /exegesis materials, it offers a small but unmediated sample of the primary manuscript.
